description: This file defines the SecurityLakeClient class in the Aws\SecurityLake namespace, extending AwsClient. It provides method annotations for interacting with the Amazon Security Lake service, including operations like creating, deleting, and updating log sources, data lakes, subscribers, etc.

classes.name: SecurityLakeClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Security Lake service, providing methods for managing data lakes, log sources, subscribers, and related operations.

methods.name: createAwsLogSource
methods.description: Creates a new AWS log source for Security Lake.

methods.name: createAwsLogSourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new AWS log source.

methods.name: createCustomLogSourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a custom log source.

methods.name: createDataLakeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new data lake.

methods.name: createDataLakeExceptionSubscription
methods.description: Creates a data lake exception subscription.

methods.name: createDataLakeExceptionSubscriptionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a data lake exception subscription.

methods.name: createDataLakeOrganizationConfiguration
methods.description: Configures organization-wide settings for the data lake.

methods.name: createDataLakeOrganizationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously configures organization settings for the data lake.

methods.name: createSubscriber
methods.description: Creates a subscriber for Security Lake.

methods.name: createSubscriberNotification
methods.description: Creates a notification for a subscriber.

methods.name: deleteAwsLogSourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an AWS log source.

methods.name: deleteCustomLogSourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a custom log source.

methods.name: deleteDataLakeExceptionSubscription
methods.description: Deletes a data lake exception subscription.

methods.name: deleteDataLakeExceptionSubscriptionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a data lake exception subscription.

methods.name: deleteDataLakeOrganizationConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes organization configuration for the data lake.

methods.name: deregisterDataLakeDelegatedAdministrator
methods.description: Deregisters a delegated administrator for the data lake.

methods.name: getDataLakeExceptionSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves details about a data lake exception subscription.

methods.name: getDataLakeExceptionSubscriptionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves data lake exception subscription details.

methods.name: getDataLakeOrganizationConfiguration
methods.description: Gets organization-wide configuration for the data lake.

methods.name: getDataLakeSources
methods.description: Retrieves data sources associated with the data lake.

methods.name: listDataLakeExceptions
methods.description: Lists exceptions in the data lake.

methods.name: registerDataLakeDelegatedAdministrator
methods.description: Registers a delegated administrator for the data lake.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateDataLakeExceptionSubscription
methods.description: Updates a data lake exception subscription.

methods.name: updateDataLakeExceptionSubscriptionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a data lake exception subscription.
